title: Webhook requests are sent using the POST method, and an HTTP 200 status is expected in response. If a different status or an error occurs, a retry mechanism is triggered, resending the data. Multiple retry attempts are made within an hour. If no successful (200) response is received after the predefined number of retries, the event is discarded.

Ypj[: Internal schedulers continuously monitor payments to finalize them. If a payment is eligible for cancellation, the system will cancel it as part of the checkout process..
If merchant wants to cancel payment before customer pays it can use cancel API. In this case cancelation party will be merchant.
M10, Birbank, or the bank can also cancel the payment. In such cases, the cancellation is initiated by the payment network.

For card payments, if the issuer declines to process the payment, the transaction will fail and the customer will be shown a failure page.
Such declines are uncommon but can occur in extreme cases.
